crossRefs.note: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Moab_Plains
people.line: Region east of the Jordan River, opposite Jericho

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
translations.bsb: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
translations.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
